name: pack-audit
description: Pack run audit — append one row to _pack_audit for any Pack. Generic cross-Pack mechanism (not industry-specific).

tools.name: append_pack_audit
tools.description: Append one audit row to sheet _pack_audit (create sheet+header if missing). Use after a Pack skill finishes reconcile/calculate/pivot. Records packId, counts, optional assumptionSnapshot (JSON of param cells) and matchRate (0–1). Do NOT invent numbers — pass counts returned by reconcile_tables.

note.description: Human-readable run note (归因说明、matchRate 警示等)

assumptionSnapshot.description: JSON string of assumption cells at run time, e.g. {"B2":7.2,"B3":0.15,"B4":0.08}

matchRate.description: matched / total (0–1). Prefer computing from reconcile counts.
